about: How a model id is written for people. The engine reports ids ('claude-sonnet-5-5[1m]', 'gpt-6-luna'), not names, so the parser in apps/desktop/ui/src/components/model-name.ts turns an id into 'Claude Sonnet 5.5', 'GPT-6 Luna', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash'. Matched on the id (the last path segment of a ref), never on the host: Claude through Bedrock is still Claude. A raw 'provider/id' is never shown.

aliases.about: Short names the Claude subscription provider accepts and the ladder uses (the Claude subscription plugin, claude-subscription-directsdk, model_catalog.py ALIASES at commit 6313fad5ddf2c060e7b16782f4860c0d5cdbfcac). An alias floats to the newest model of its tier, so it is named by its tier only; the pinned id it points at today is `pinned`, used to fold the same model listed twice into one row.

words.about: Words that are not written as Title Case. Everything else is Title Case; a number or a version (3.8, v3.2, 4o) stays as written; a size (70b) is upper case.

drop.about: Words that say nothing a person needs: a packaging, a quantisation or a moving-target word. A date stamp (20251001, a trailing 2501 or 0905) is dropped too.

dispatch.about: What a person calls a model when he tells a session which model gets which task ('send this one to codex'). The plugin's delegation backend (plugins/boopis/governance/roster.py) builds the aliases of delegate_task's `target` from this table and from `aliases` above; a model is always reachable by its own id too. A provider's words name its first listed model; two providers claiming a word give it to the one listed first.

providers.about: The provider's own plan or service, the secondary text under a model, never the model's name. The engine's own name for a provider (model.options `name`) is used for a slug not listed here.
